title: Maximum Performance of a Team
description: Maximize performance defined as (sum of speeds) * (minimum efficiency) by choosing at most k engineers.
pseudocode:
1. Pair speed and efficiency, sort by efficiency descending
2. Iterate through engineers, maintain min-heap of k-1 highest speeds
3. Track sum of speeds in heap, calculate perf = sum * current_efficiency
4. Update max_perf

steps.note: Process engineer (speed=1, eff=9). Heap: [1], sum=1, perf=1*9=9
Process engineer (speed=5, eff=7). Heap: [1, 5], sum=6, perf=6*7=42
Process engineer (speed=2, eff=5). Heap size > k, remove smallest 1. Heap: [2, 5], sum=7, perf=7*5=35
Process engineer (speed=10, eff=4). Remove smallest 2. Heap: [5, 10], sum=15, perf=15*4=60
Process engineer (speed=3, eff=3). Remove smallest 3. Heap: [5, 10], sum=15, perf=15*3=45
